label: Transcript hook
description: Reaches out privately to a participant who has been quiet, using a specific moment from the transcript to open a relevant, low-pressure conversation thread.

conditions.condition: the recent transcript has been dense or fast-moving — dense means multiple concepts delivered quickly, significant information density, or a pace that could leave people behind; sparse means introductory remarks, pauses, light content, or a slow pace

conditions: the participant has been silent for an extended period

guardrails: don't imply the participant was lost or not paying attention
don't make the participant feel called out for being quiet
frame as a low-pressure offer to catch up, not a check on whether they followed
examples: Things moved pretty fast just now — happy to recap anything if it would help.
There was a lot just covered in a short stretch — let me know if you want me to break any of it down.
